name: Hamanaka (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Hamanaka town emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised arrow pointing upward.
history: Municipal flag of Hamanaka, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 1963.

features.role: Hamanaka town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised arrow pointing upward
